macro_opportunities.theme_summary: CoreWeave beat earnings today, Anthropic valuation surging to $1.5T+, and SpaceX planning a $24B data center — the AI infrastructure buildout is accelerating beyond hyperscalers into new entrants, creating demand across the supply chain.

plays.why_underrated: Power and cooling infrastructure for data centers is the bottleneck nobody is pricing in yet — VRT supplies the thermal management critical to AI compute density.
plays.catalyst: SpaceX $24B data center project and expanding hyperscaler capex create new demand channels beyond traditional cloud customers.

plays.why_underrated: Electrical infrastructure contractor benefiting from data center power buildout — less crowded than direct AI plays but critical to enabling the capacity expansion.
plays.catalyst: Every new data center announcement (SpaceX, CoreWeave expansion) translates to electrical grid and infrastructure contracts.

plays.why_underrated: Data center networking demand scales with every new AI cluster — Arista's high-speed switching is essential infrastructure often overshadowed by GPU headlines.
plays.catalyst: CoreWeave earnings beat signals accelerating AI cluster deployments requiring Arista's networking solutions.

macro_opportunities.theme_summary: Credit card debt hitting record highs while gas prices fall below $4/gallon creates a divergence — consumers are stretched but getting relief at the pump. Energy sector led +1.86% today despite falling gas prices, suggesting upstream/midstream resilience.

plays.why_underrated: Value retail benefits from consumer trade-down behavior as credit card debt hits records — Costco's membership model provides recurring revenue stability.
plays.catalyst: Consumer stress accelerating trade-down to warehouse clubs; gas price relief frees incremental spending for bulk essentials.

plays.why_underrated: Deep discount retail directly benefits from consumer financial stress — stock has been beaten down and could re-rate as consumer weakness data confirms their value proposition.
plays.catalyst: Record credit card debt headline cycle puts spotlight on discount retail as the consumer resilience play.

macro_opportunities.theme_summary: US military concerns about launch supply crunch and SpaceX's $24B data center project highlight growing intersection of defense, space, and digital infrastructure. This theme is under-covered relative to AI hype.

plays.why_underrated: Launch supply crunch directly benefits the only other operational orbital-class launch provider besides SpaceX — military demand for alternative launch providers is growing.
plays.catalyst: US military launch supply crunch news creates urgency for diversifying launch providers beyond SpaceX.

plays.why_underrated: Space-based communications and ISR assets are critical to military readiness — LHX trades at a discount to peers while benefiting from both space and defense themes.
plays.catalyst: Growing military concern about space access and infrastructure creates sustained demand for satellite and communications systems.
